# Modern Redesign Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Give every page of nestnrestcleaning.com a cleaner, modern look (Plus Jakarta Sans headlines, white and ivory surfaces, pill buttons, soft cards, a reworked homepage hero) without changing how anything works.

**Architecture:** The site is static HTML generated by `tools/build.mjs` from `js/config.js`, styled by one stylesheet, `css/site.css`, with behaviour in `js/site.js`. The redesign is mostly a token and component rewrite in `css/site.css`, plus markup changes in `tools/build.mjs` for the homepage hero, trust strip and section heads. A browser test suite is added at `tools/qa/` first, so every later task proves it changed only the look.

**Tech Stack:** Node 22 (ES modules), plain CSS with custom properties, Playwright (Chromium) for tests, Python not required.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-28-modern-redesign-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Headings: Plus Jakarta Sans (variable 200–800), self-hosted at `assets/fonts/plus-jakarta-sans.woff2`, OFL licence at `assets/fonts/LICENSE-Plus-Jakarta-Sans.txt`. h1/h2 weight 800, letter-spacing −0.03em; h3 weight 700, letter-spacing −0.015em. Sentence case: no `text-transform: uppercase` on headings, labels, buttons or links.
- Body, labels, form text: DM Sans (unchanged file).
- Barlow Condensed is removed: both `.woff2` files, `LICENSE-Barlow-Condensed.txt`, its `@font-face` rules and its preload.
- Type scale (desktop / phone): home h1 76 / 48px; page h1 60 / 40px; h2 46 / 32px; h3 21–24px; lede 19 / 17px; body 17px.
- Colours stay: navy `#0A2D5C`, teal `#2FA4A6`, teal-ink `#1A7476`, teal-deep `#23898B`, sky `#6FC3E0`, sand `#EFD9AE`, ivory `#F7F3EA`. Light page background `#FFFFFF`; ivory is the alternate section tint. Dark mode keeps today's dark tokens.
- Components: buttons are pills, 52px tall (`.btn-sm` 44px); cards 20px radius; navy bands and final call to action 28px radius, inset in the page width; fields 14px radius; icon chips 42px with a soft-teal background.
- Label pill (`.label`, `.kicker`): DM Sans 13px bold, teal-ink on pale teal, with a dot.
- Hero subheading, exact copy: `Your weekends are for living, not scrubbing. Mann cleans your home with care, so you come back to calm, and you pay only after the clean.` ("Mann" comes from `B.ownerFirstName`.)
- Behaviour is frozen: no change to `js/site.js` logic. Every existing `data-*` hook, id and form `name` stays.
- Contrast: 4.5:1 or better for normal text and 3:1 for large text and controls, in light and dark.
- Hover lift only under `@media (hover: hover) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`.
- No invented reviews, ratings, badges or stock people photos.
- After any change to `tools/build.mjs`, `js/config.js` or `css/site.css`: run `node tools/build.mjs` and commit the regenerated pages with the source.

## Review Focus

- **Dark mode on new surfaces:** a hard-coded light colour (e.g. `#fff`) in a new rule makes a white panel under light dark-mode text. Every text element sampled by the contrast test must reach 4.5:1 in dark mode too. (Task 3 test `contrast holds in both themes`.)
- **Label pills on navy:** `.label-light` sits on the navy standard band, the founding card and the footer; a pale pill there can drop below contrast. (Task 3 test `labels on navy stay readable`.)
- **Font path typos:** a wrong preload or `@font-face` URL silently falls back to system fonts. Every page must load with no 404 on any asset, and h1 must actually render in Plus Jakarta Sans. (Task 2 test `fonts load from the new file`; Task 1 layout check `no asset 404s`.)
- **Reduced motion and touch:** card hover lift must not run when reduced motion is requested. (Task 3 test `no hover lift with reduced motion`.)
- **The 404 page** is generated separately and uses `.display` classes; it must render in the new type with no overflow. (Task 1 layout check covers `/404.html`; Task 2 asserts its h1 font.)

### Task 1: Browser test suite in the repo

Turns the ad-hoc checks from the audit work into an assertion-based suite, so each later task can prove the behaviour didn't change.

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/qa/lib.mjs`, `tools/qa/run.mjs`, `tools/qa/booking.test.mjs`, `tools/qa/privacy.test.mjs`, `tools/qa/layout.test.mjs`, `tools/qa/perf.mjs`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces, in `tools/qa/lib.mjs`:
  - `chromium` — loaded with `createRequire(import.meta.url)("playwright")` (an ES `import` of `playwright` fails in this environment).
  - `startServer(root: string): Promise<{ url: string, close(): Promise<void> }>` — Node `http` static server on a free port. It serves `index.html` for `/dir/` and returns 404 otherwise.
  - `newPage(browser, { width, height, theme = "light", timezoneId, reducedMotion }): Promise<Page>` — sets `localStorage["nr-theme"]` before load, aborts `googletagmanager|google-analytics|cal.com`, and exposes `page.posts` (an array of parsed FormSubmit bodies).
  - `mockDelivery(page, mode: "ok" | "empty200" | "badjson" | "falsy" | "neterr")` — fulfils `formsubmit.co` requests accordingly.
  - `contrast(fg: string, bg: string): number` — WCAG ratio from CSS `rgb()`/`rgba()`/hex strings, with rgba composited over its background.
  - `test(name: string, fn: (ctx) => Promise<void>)` registry, and `assert(cond, message)`.
- Each `*.test.mjs` exports `default async function (ctx)` that calls `test(...)`. `ctx` is `{ browser, url }`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write `tools/qa/lib.mjs` and `tools/qa/run.mjs`**

`run.mjs` tests the pages as they are on disk; it doesn't rebuild them (each task rebuilds first). It serves the repo root with `startServer`, launches Chromium once, imports every `tools/qa/*.test.mjs` in name order and runs their tests one after another. It prints `PASS name` or `FAIL name: message` and exits 1 if any test failed. An optional argument filters by file name (`node tools/qa/run.mjs design`).

- [ ] **Step 2: Write `tools/qa/booking.test.mjs` with these tests**

```js
test("move-out never charges for included extras", async ({ browser, url }) => {
  // /book/?s=deep&h=house&bd=3&ba=2, postal M1P 1A1, tick oven + pets  -> total "$408"
  // tick laundry -> "$428"; switch to move -> "$392"
  // walls row: class includes "is-included", input disabled+checked, price text "Included"
  // laundry row: "is-none", "Not offered"; force-click walls -> total still "$392"
  // [data-scope-note] mentions "Laundry, wash and fold isn't part of"
  // switch back to deep -> laundry unchecked
});
test("stale draft is normalized", ...);          // nr-quote-v1 {service:"move", addons:["walls","laundry","pets"], ...} -> "$392"
test("old personal draft is migrated and deleted", ...); // nr-booking-v2 with f-name -> localStorage keys == ["nr-quote-v1"], #f-name empty
test("request is only 'sent' on explicit success", ...); // modes empty200, badjson, falsy, neterr: [data-done] hidden, [data-form-error] visible; then ok: done visible
test("retries keep one reference", ...);       // all posts in the previous test share one /^NR-[A-Z0-9]{4}$/ Reference
test("personal details stay in the tab and clear after sending", ...); // localStorage never contains the typed name; sessionStorage empty after success
test("review edit returns to the step with choices kept", ...); // type notes, click first Edit for step 2 -> step 2 visible, freq and date still checked
test("Toronto dates on a Vancouver device", ...); // timezoneId America/Vancouver: first date chip value == openDates computed in America/Toronto
test("long cleans can't pick late windows", ...); // deep house 3/2 + oven + pets: afternoon & evening inputs disabled, morning/midday/any enabled
test("large homes go to a quote with details carried", ...); // tick large -> Continue blocked; quote link lands on /services/residence-care/ with #q-notes starting "From the booking form: Deep Cleaning"
test("focused controls are never under the sticky bars", ...); // 390x700, Tab through each step: no focused control intersects .step-nav or .summary
```

The test bodies follow the earlier scratchpad scripts (`scope.js`, `flow.js`, `screen.js`, `keys.js`) with each `console.log` turned into an `assert`.

- [ ] **Step 4: Write `tools/qa/layout.test.mjs`**

```js
const PAGES = ["/", "/pricing/", "/services/move-in-move-out-cleaning/", "/services/regular-home-cleaning/",
  "/areas/north-york/", "/areas/north-york/willowdale/", "/help/", "/realtors/", "/privacy/", "/policies/",
  "/services/residence-care/", "/gift/", "/guides/", "/vision/", "/404.html"];

// for theme in light/dark, width in WIDTHS, path in PAGES:
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write `tools/qa/perf.mjs`**

Same method as the earlier baseline. Five templates, a 390x844 mobile context, CDP network latency 150ms at 1.6 Mbps down / 750 kbps up, CPU slowed 4×, three cold runs each. Print the median LCP and CLS and the LCP element. Exit 1 if any median LCP is over 2.2s or any CLS is over 0.05.

- [ ] **Step 6: Run the suite against today's site**

Run: `node tools/qa/run.mjs && node tools/qa/perf.mjs`
Expected: every test `PASS`; perf medians about 1.9s LCP and CLS 0.000. If a test fails on today's site, the test is wrong: fix the test, not the site.

- [ ] **Step 7: Commit**

```bash

git commit -m "Add the browser test suite for booking, privacy, layout and speed"
```
